properties.public_notes: Turkey Creek is shown as a generalized public-map named-water occurrence for Yellowfin cutthroat historic context. This object is separated from other same-named waters using HUC8, lineage, and local spatial clustering. Linework is grouped from public hydrography and should be treated as interpretive watershed context, not a precise biological boundary.
